item.title: Exploring the Intersection of Robotics and Cybersecurity at AsturCON.tech 2026
item.description: EXPLICIT researchers Adrián Campazas Vega and Claudia Álvarez Aparicio presented the talk “Robotics and Cybersecurity?” at AsturCON.tech 2026, a non-profit conference focused on cybersecurity held in Avilés, Spain.

item.title: Presenting the EXPLICIT Project at ROBOT2026
item.description: Francisco J. Rodríguez-Lera presented the EXPLICIT project poster at ROBOT2026, showcasing its approach to operational traceability, blockchain-based evidence storage and LLM-based explanations for autonomous systems.

item.title: REGAL: Accessible and Trustworthy Explanations for Robots with ROS
item.description: Vicente Barreiro Serrano and Francisco Javier Rodríguez Lera from the University of León presented REGAL, a work on accessible and trustworthy explanations for robots using ROS, at ROSCon España 2026 in Valencia.

item.title: Our Contribution to the REAIM Summit: Responsible AI and Ethics in Defense
item.description: Project PI Vicente Matellán represented our team as a panelist at the REAIM Summit, discussing the explainability and traceability of AI models in military operations.
